proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E _ _ _ M N hc hM hN
  have ht : Submodule.IsTopCompl M N := Submodule.IsCompl.isTopCompl_of_isClosed hc hM hN
  refine ⟨M.subtypeL.comp (M.projectionOntoL N ht), fun x hx => ?_, fun y hy => ?_, fun x => (M.projectionOntoL N ht x).2⟩
  · have := Submodule.projectionOntoL_apply_left ht ⟨x, hx⟩
    simp [this]
  · have := (Submodule.projectionOntoL_apply_eq_zero_iff ht).mpr hy
    simp [this]
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] (M N : Submodule 𝕜 E), IsCompl M N → IsClosed (M : Set E) → IsClosed (N : Set E) → ∃ P : E →L[𝕜] E, (∀ x ∈ M, P x = x) ∧ (∀ y ∈ N, P y = 0) ∧ (∀ x, P x ∈ M)
